announcements.headline: 2026 Full Year Results Presentation
summary: FY2026 results presentation flagged as market sensitive, signalling material financial outcomes that deviate meaningfully from prior guidance or consensus expectations — investors should scrutinise EBITDA margins and net debt trajectory given Bega's ongoing balance sheet repair following its 2022 Lion Dairy & Drinks acquisition integration.

Key metrics to watch include branded vs. bulk dairy revenue mix, cost-of-milk input pressures, and whether Bega has achieved its targeted margin recovery in its consumer and foodservice segments, which have been under pressure from elevated commodity and logistics costs across FY2025-26.

Forward guidance on capital allocation — particularly debt reduction milestones, dividend reinstatement prospects, and any strategic portfolio rationalisation — will be critical catalysts for re-rating, as the market has been awaiting evidence of sustainable free cash flow generation to justify the current enterprise value.

announcements.headline: FY26 Results Presentation

Forward guidance and order book visibility will be critical catalysts; with Australian infrastructure pipelines remaining robust, a reaffirmation or upgrade to FY27 targets could re-rate the stock, while any softening in real estate settlement volumes or quarry throughput amid cost inflation would weigh on near-term sentiment.

Next steps will hinge on the scope of the expanded acreage, earn-in terms, and whether new drilling commitments are triggered — investors should watch for a formal JV agreement or work program announcement to assess whether this translates into near-term catalysts or remains an optionality play.

announcements.headline: Half Yearly Results Investor Presentation
summary: Pepper Money's half-yearly investor presentation is market sensitive, signalling material financial disclosures that could meaningfully re-rate the stock — institutional investors should scrutinise net interest margin trends and loan book growth given the elevated rate environment's dual impact on funding costs and arrears pressure in non-bank lending.

announcements.headline: Half Yearly Results Announcement
summary: Pepper Money's half-yearly results represent a critical inflection point for the non-bank lender, with institutional focus squarely on net interest margin compression amid elevated funding costs and whether the mortgage book can sustain growth against a backdrop of tightening credit conditions in the Australian non-conforming lending space.

Key metrics to watch include loan origination volumes, arrears rates across the mortgage and asset finance portfolios, and cost-of-funds trajectory — any deterioration in 30+ day delinquencies would signal meaningful credit quality risk given Pepper's exposure to near-prime and specialist borrowers who are disproportionately impacted by the high interest rate environment.

Forward guidance on securitisation pipeline and warehouse facility headroom will be pivotal for the outlook; if management reaffirms origination targets and demonstrates margin stabilisation, the stock could re-rate, but any downward revision to FY earnings or dividend sustainability would likely accelerate selling pressure given the stock's already compressed valuation multiples.

announcements.headline: Half Yearly Report and Accounts

announcements.headline: Ternera Infill Returns Wide, High-Grade Gold Intercepts
summary: Infill drilling at Ternera is de-risking the resource base by confirming grade continuity across the deposit — wide, high-grade intercepts from infill holes directly support a potential resource upgrade, a critical catalyst for re-rating a junior gold explorer.

High-grade gold results from a market-sensitive release signal results materially above expectations or prior drilling benchmarks, suggesting Ternera could host a higher-confidence, higher-grade core than previously modelled — key for attracting institutional interest or a strategic partner.

The next logical step is a revised MRE (Mineral Resource Estimate) incorporating the infill data; investors should watch for the timeline to that update, as it will determine whether Tesoro can advance toward a PFS and unlock the next stage of project financing or M&A optionality.

announcements.headline: Ceasing to be a substantial holder
summary: A substantial holder has fallen below the 5% ownership threshold in OOH!Media (OML), triggering a mandatory disclosure — this signals a meaningful reduction in a major institutional position, potentially reflecting reduced conviction in the out-of-home advertising sector's near-term outlook.

The exit of a substantial holder introduces incremental selling pressure overhang risk; depending on the pace and scale of the disposal, this could weigh on OML's share price if the stock was absorbed without sufficient buy-side demand to offset the supply.

Investors should monitor subsequent 13D/13G-equivalent filings and OML's register for signs of further institutional repositioning — a thinning institutional base can reduce liquidity support and elevate volatility, particularly in a cyclical media name sensitive to advertising spend conditions.

announcements.headline: DYM Advances Exploration Portfolio
summary: Market-sensitive classification signals material exploration developments across DYM's portfolio — likely encompassing drill results, new target identification, or resource updates that could re-rate the stock if assay data is substantive.

As a junior explorer, DYM's valuation is highly leverage to exploration newsflow; any high-grade intercepts or expanded footprint at key projects (notably Widgiemooltha or similar WA tenements) would directly catalyse institutional interest and potential re-rating of in-ground value.

Near-term focus will be on whether the update includes drill-ready targets with defined timelines and sufficient cash runway to execute — investors should scrutinise the balance sheet position and planned work programs to assess whether a capital raise is imminent to fund ongoing exploration.

announcements.headline: Lat66 Unlocks Value through Sale of Royalty Portfolio $3.4m

Management's willingness to divest non-core royalty interests signals a disciplined capital allocation strategy focused on highest-conviction assets; investors should watch for deployment of proceeds into drill programs or resource development to validate this strategic pivot.

announcements.headline: Change in substantial holding

announcements.headline: Ceasing to be a substantial holder

Investors should monitor the register closely for any corresponding substantial holder notices from new entrants, which could indicate a block trade or strategic transfer of the stake rather than an outright liquidation — the latter would be more constructive for the share price outlook.

announcements.headline: DRILLING ACHIEVES 150M SOUTHWEST STRIKE EXTENSION
summary: The 150-metre southwest strike extension is a material resource delineation milestone, meaningfully expanding the known mineralised footprint and increasing the probability of a larger-than-anticipated resource estimate — a key re-rating catalyst for a junior explorer.

Strike extensions of this magnitude typically signal open-ended mineralisation, suggesting the deposit remains unconstrained in at least one direction; this materially de-risks future drilling programs and supports a step-change in resource tonnage potential.

Near-term focus will shift to follow-up infill and extensional drilling to convert the strike extension into a JORC-compliant resource update — investors should watch for drill program announcements, assay results, and any updated resource estimate timeline as the next value-inflection triggers.

announcements.headline: FY26 Appendix 4E & Annual Report

announcements.headline: High-Grade Rock Chips at Gidgee Gold Project
summary: High-grade rock chip results at Gidgee Gold Project signal potential for a significant mineralised system — surface sampling returning elevated gold values in a historically productive WA goldfield materially de-risks early-stage exploration and supports a re-rating catalyst ahead of systematic drilling programs.

The market-sensitive classification underscores management's view that assay grades are materially above background levels, suggesting results likely include multi-gram or potentially bonanza-grade intercepts consistent with orogenic gold systems typical of the Murchison region — key detail investors should scrutinise in the full release.

Near-term catalysts hinge on the company's ability to convert rock chip anomalies into a drill-ready target — investors should monitor follow-up soil/auger sampling timelines, tenure security, and whether the company holds sufficient cash runway (typically sub-$5M for micro-cap explorers) to fund a maiden RC or diamond drilling program without near-term dilutive capital raises.

announcements.headline: Santy Delivers High-Grade Tungsten & Polymetallic Results
summary: High-grade tungsten intersections at Santy represent a strategically significant discovery given tungsten's critical mineral status and tight global supply chains dominated by China — positioning Catalina as a potential domestic source of strategic importance to Australian and allied-nation supply security.

Polymetallic nature of the results (tungsten plus additional metals) enhances project economics by offering multiple revenue streams, potentially improving project NPV and lowering the effective cost of tungsten production — a key de-risking factor for early-stage explorers seeking to attract institutional or government-backed funding.

As a market-sensitive announcement, the next catalyst will be follow-up drilling to test strike and depth extensions of the high-grade zones; investors should watch for a maiden resource estimate timeline and any commentary on metallurgical testwork, which are the critical milestones needed to advance Santy toward a scoping study.

announcements.headline: Wide Copper-Gold Intercepts Extend Growing Nanadie Deposit
summary: Deposit extension confirmed at Nanadie: Wide copper-gold intercepts expanding the known mineralised footprint signal a potentially significant resource upgrade cycle, which is the key value-creation catalyst for junior explorers at this stage of development.

The market-sensitive classification underscores material drill results — wide intercepts (as opposed to narrow high-grade hits) are particularly significant for open-pit economics, improving the likelihood of a bulk-tonnage, lower-cost mining scenario that institutional investors typically re-rate favourably.

Next steps will be critical: the market will focus on whether Solstice accelerates infill and extensional drilling to support a maiden or upgraded JORC resource estimate, with any resource announcement likely to be the next major share-price catalyst and potential trigger for strategic interest from larger copper-focused producers.

announcements.headline: Large-Scale Mineral System Emerging at Bald Peaks
summary: The characterisation of a 'large-scale mineral system' at Bald Peaks is a significant re-rating catalyst for a junior explorer — this language typically signals multi-kilometre structural controls and potential for resource-scale mineralisation, elevating the project from prospect to district-scale opportunity in the market's eyes.

Market-sensitive classification underscores that new technical data — likely geophysical, geochemical, or drilling results — materially changes the investment thesis; investors should scrutinise the scale of anomalies, grade intercepts, and strike length disclosed to assess whether the system justifies a step-change in exploration expenditure.

Near-term focus will be on whether Bison Resources has sufficient cash runway to advance Bald Peaks through the next drill programme — any capital raise risk or need for a JV partner to fund follow-up work will be a key overhang to monitor against the exploration upside narrative.

announcements.headline: 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate and Ore Reserves
summary: Westgold's FY2026 MRE/Ore Reserve update is a critical valuation anchor — any material increase in contained gold ounces or reserve grade would directly support mine life extension and underpin the company's multi-asset production growth narrative following the transformative Karora Resources merger in 2024.

Investors should scrutinise reserve replacement rates relative to FY2025 depletion; a reserve-to-production ratio above 1.0x signals organic replenishment is keeping pace with mining, while grade reconciliation across Beta Hunt and Bluebird-Super Pit will be key indicators of geological confidence and future mill feed quality.

The market-sensitive classification suggests potentially material changes to the resource/reserve inventory — if the update confirms expanded high-grade underground resources at Beta Hunt's Father's Day Vein or Bluebird, this could catalyse upward revisions to consensus NAV estimates and strengthen Westgold's positioning as a mid-tier ASX gold producer with a credible 400,000+ oz/year growth pathway.

announcements.headline: Change in substantial holding from FRS and Interim Orders

Investors should watch for subsequent filings clarifying whether FRS's stake is being reduced, frozen, or transferred — any forced or distressed selling of a substantial holding in a small-cap miner can create material downward price pressure once orders are lifted or resolved.

Key near-term catalysts to watch include appointment of an adviser, indicative bid timelines, and whether the review encompasses all copper tenements or a targeted subset — outcomes that will determine whether this is a full asset divestment, partial stake sale, or strategic JV that retains upside for existing shareholders.

announcements.headline: TLM Announces Board Changes to Drive Next Growth Chapter
summary: Board restructuring at a junior explorer signals a strategic inflection point — incoming directors likely bring capital markets, M&A, or technical expertise aligned with advancing Talisman's copper-gold pipeline in WA, though the market will scrutinise whether new appointments represent genuine strategic firepower or routine housekeeping.

Investors should monitor the subsequent Appendix 3X/3Y filings and any accompanying strategy update; board changes alone carry limited standalone value, but if paired with a refreshed exploration strategy or funding announcement, this could mark the beginning of a re-rating cycle for a stock that has traded at subdued levels.

The market-sensitive classification elevates urgency for institutional positioning; with Brambles trading on a premium multiple relative to industrial peers, any guidance revision — positive or negative — is likely to drive outsized price movement, making this a high-priority read-through for logistics and industrials sector exposure.

announcements.headline: AFG FY26 Results Investor Presentation

announcements.headline: FY26 Financial Results Presentation

announcements.headline: FY26 Financial Results

Balance sheet strength and capital allocation signals — particularly dividend quantum, debt reduction trajectory, and any updated FY27 guidance or growth project timelines at the Superpit expansion — will determine whether institutional investors re-rate the stock toward the upper end of its peer multiple range.

Investors should watch closely for FY dividend declaration, balance sheet positioning (net debt/cash), and any forward guidance updates — particularly around the Pogo (Alaska) and KCGM (Super Pit) operations — as these will set the tone for FY26 capital allocation expectations and potential buyback or growth capex announcements.

announcements.headline: EHL FY26 Results Presentation

Investors should monitor the scale and pace of the buyback program (volume limits, total capital committed, and duration) as these parameters will determine the materiality of the earnings accretion and the strength of the price support signal in the near term.

Near-term focus will centre on FY27 guidance and any update to the dividend policy, particularly whether the NZ$0.25/share annual dividend is maintained or rebased — a cut or suspension would represent a significant sentiment reset for income-oriented institutional holders and could catalyse further de-rating of the stock.
